tool.name: create-cart
tool.description:
Create a cart for a restaurant location using unit token and a list of item selections.
Use standard/first variation if no variation is explicitly specified. Use CALI_ prefixed IDs for menu item,
and CALIV_ prefixed IDs for menu item variations. Fill both menu item and menu item variations when they are available.
Any item requiring a modifier requires a modifierId field (singular, using CALIM_ prefix from the menu's modifier data).
If a modifier has minSelection >= 1, at least one modifier from that list must be included.

unitToken.description: The unit token identifying the location

fulfillment.description: Optional fulfillment details. Set type to PICKUP for pick-up orders or DELIVERY for delivery orders. Defaults to PICKUP.

discountCodes.description: Optional array of discount codes to apply

quantity.description: The quantity of the item selected (minimum 1, maximum 999)
The quantity of this modifier (default 1, minimum 1, maximum 999)

modifierId.description: The id of the modifier using the CALIM_ prefixed modifier id.

currency.description: The ISO-4217 currency code of this modifier

total_price.description: The total price of this modifier

menuItemId.description: The id for the menu item selected. This id should start with CALI_ prefix.

inputtedText.description: The input text of the modifier

menuItemMenuModifierId.description: The menu item modifier list id using the CALIL_ prefixed item modifier list id

textModifiers.description: Optional array of text modifier selections

menuItemVariationId.description: Optional id of menu item variation for the item selected. This id should start with CALIV_ prefix.

cartLineSelections.description: Array of cart line selections (items to add to cart)

_published_faq.name: How do I add block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.squareup.com/v2/mcp/cash-app.

_published_faq.name: Is block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server scores 65/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 5 of 5 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server provides these MCP tools: discover-nearby-restaurants, get-multiple-menus, get-restaurant-ordering-view, get-single-menu-view, get-single-menu, create-cart, and app_create-cart.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can block-cash-app-ordering-mcp-server improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: create-cart is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 55/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields.
